slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck; it explicitly assumed no route capacity limits.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There are no truck capacity limits; each truck can carry an unlimited number of containers.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about truck capacity and later stated 'No route capacity limits' in its READY_TO_MODEL summary, despite U6 specifying that each truck can carry up to 2 containers.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, which does not affect the core optimization problem or objective value; the agent resolved the key demand/supply interpretation before stopping.

summary: The agent clarified the critical demand-equality and surplus-treatment issues but missed the low-impact truck capacity detail, silently assuming no capacity limits. Overall, the interaction was sufficient for the core transportation model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
